popular.title: The Odyssey
popular.plot: After the Trojan War, a king sets out on a long and dangerous journey home. He must contend with divine forces, mythological creatures, and trials that test his ingenuity and humanity.

popular.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
popular.plot: Set in Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, the story begins on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Hunger Games, known as the Second Quarter Quell. It returns to the world of the series at the start of this event.

popular.title: Heart of the Beast
popular.plot: After a plane crash, a Special Forces officer and his combat dog are stranded in the Alaskan wilderness. They must face the elements together in a fight to survive.

popular.title: Iron Man
popular.plot: After being captured in a cave in Afghanistan, a billionaire engineer builds a powerful suit of armor to escape. Back home, he turns his invention toward fighting evil.

popular.title: Kalki 2898-AD
popular.plot: In 2898 AD, a bounty hunter in a dystopian world becomes an obstacle to a warrior seeking redemption as hope begins to emerge. Their paths cross amid a struggle shaped by ancient mythology and a perilous future.

popular.title: Guarding Stars
popular.plot: A no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays. Sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas becomes more complicated.

popular.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
popular.plot: A young crimefighter works full-time in a city that no longer remembers him, while his old friends move on without him. As he faces an unsettling change within himself, he may have to master it to stop a new threat endangering the city and those he cares about.

popular.title: Resident Evil
popular.plot: A medical courier is caught in a horrifying outbreak during one chaotic night and must fight to survive.

popular.title: Hope
popular.plot: In a remote South Korean village, local police investigate a mysterious creature causing havoc in the community. As events escalate, confusion and human conflict deepen the danger.

popular.title: Other Mommy
popular.plot: A young girl forms a connection with a sinister presence in her home, one that looks uncannily like her mother. As the entity draws her into an increasingly frightening world, her family faces a growing threat.

popular.title: A Story of Derry
popular.plot: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

popular.title: Apocalypse Z: New World
popular.plot: After a virus outbreak leaves the Canary Islands as Europe’s last refuge, a special mission heads to the mainland for vital supplies. A man with questionable intentions joins the team, and the operation becomes a struggle to survive amid infected hordes and divided loyalties.

popular.title: Beware Boiúna
popular.plot: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens. The jungle turns into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.

popular.title: The Mosquito Bowl
popular.plot: After Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the Marines. Their bond is tested as they encounter the realities of war and the cost of service.

popular.title: Never Surrender
popular.plot: When a deadly gang targets a veteran’s remote home, he and the estranged grandchildren he barely knows must work together to survive.

popular.title: You Can See Everything
popular.plot: Thirty-four days before she is due to begin a prison sentence, a notorious Silicon Valley founder invites a skeptical film crew to document her daily life. What starts as an intimate portrait develops into a three-year journey.

popular.title: Steps
popular.plot: A misunderstood stepsister is blamed for disrupting a royal ball with a stolen magic wand. After a spell goes wrong, she teams up with Cinderella and an unexpected ally to try to save the kingdom and mend a fractured fairytale.

popular.title: The Hunger Games
popular.plot: In a dystopian society, the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes into a televised fight to the death. A girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, beginning a struggle for survival and defiance.

popular.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
popular.plot: After surviving the Hunger Games, two victors face the consequences of their victory as unrest spreads across Panem. Forced back into the public eye, they become symbols of hope and resistance while the Capitol prepares another deadly challenge.

popular.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
popular.plot: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and exile begin a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny leads toward greater challenges.

upcoming.title: Tangles
upcoming.plot: A young woman returns to her conservative hometown to care for her mother, who has Alzheimer’s. As she faces the illness and her unusual family, she must reckon with what her family needs from her.

upcoming.title: Ben'Imana
upcoming.plot: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

upcoming.title: Mutter: The Diary of a Mother
upcoming.plot: On the fog-drenched Black Sea coast, a woman gives birth to a being that defies nature. As her body and mind begin to unravel, love becomes both her devotion and her disease.

upcoming.title: You Don't Belong Here
upcoming.plot: A hospital leader in a small hometown raises his teenage son alone while remaining unaware of the boy’s secret nighttime activities. Their lives are thrown into turmoil when police suspicion turns toward the son in connection with a serious crime.

upcoming.title: Nothing Short of A Miracle
upcoming.plot: On Christmas Eve in New York City, a desperate new father whose reckless business ambition entangled him with a crime boss. He races to save his kidnapped newborn son. Unknown to him guided by a mysterious old-fashioned stranger who leads him toward saving his son before the night ends. The true beauty is revealed when the mysterious stranger's identity becomes known. A story of hope, faith and a Christmas miracle.

upcoming.title: Ari
upcoming.plot: During a school inspector’s visit, a young student teacher collapses and is forced out of his home by his disappointed father. Alone in the city, he reconnects with old friends while his shifting memories lead him to reassess their lives—and his own sense of failure.

upcoming.title: Le Faux Soir
upcoming.plot: In German-occupied Belgium in November 1943, a resistance organization risks grave danger to publish a spoof edition of the country’s main propaganda-controlled newspaper. The publication satirizes the German occupiers and is considered the first act of media hacking in history.

upcoming.title: Ray Gunn
upcoming.plot: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

upcoming.title: Behemoth!
upcoming.plot: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

upcoming.title: The Education of Jane Cumming
upcoming.plot: Edinburgh, 1810. Two female teachers find themselves at the centre of a scandal when one of their pupils accuses them of having a love affair.

upcoming.title: Flesh & Fuel
upcoming.plot: Étienne is a truck driver. Addicted to the road, he reduces his emotional life to anonymous and fleeting encounters in parking lots. When he meets Bartosz, a Polish truck driver, his solitary routine is turned upside down.

upcoming.title: 2m²
upcoming.plot: An undertaker serving a close-knit immigrant community is pulled into the most personal decisions families face after a loss. As he guides them through grief, tradition, and practical realities, each case forces him to balance empathy with the weight of choosing a final resting place.

upcoming.title: It Will Happen Tonight
upcoming.plot: In Oslo, Thea and Matteo are awaiting the birth of their child. Meanwhile, in Mumbai, Charles asks Greta to marry him in public. Seven years later, in Rome, Matteo is playing tennis when Greta shows up for a match, dressed as a bride. For him it's love at first sight, but she's just married. Life goes on, yet Matteo cannot forget Greta. Seven years later, they meet again by chance; both are married and have children with other people. Love always brings them together at the wrong time. Loosely based on the short story collection "Legami" by Eshkol Nevo.

upcoming.title: Eternal Return
upcoming.plot: After losing someone she deeply loved, a young woman becomes emotionally closed off and abandons her former dreams. A chance meeting with a cartographer introduces her to magical maps connected to meaningful moments, prompting a journey through memory, loss, and the possibility of opening her heart again.

upcoming.title: The Gallerist
upcoming.plot: Set against the glittering excess of Art Basel Miami, a desperate gallery owner conspires to pass off an accidental corpse as the centerpiece of her debut show.

upcoming.title: I See Buildings Fall like Lightning
upcoming.plot: Once inseparable, a group of childhood friends spent their early years playing, skipping school, and imagining the lives they might lead. Now in their thirties, they face the quiet realization that the future they pictured may be slipping out of reach.

upcoming.title: A Long Winter
upcoming.plot: High in the mountains, autumn comes to an end as a family prepares for the long winter ahead. In their remote surroundings, the changing season creates an uncertain period of preparation, bringing the family together as they face what lies ahead.

upcoming.title: The Friend's House Is Here
upcoming.plot: In Tehran’s underground art scene, two young women create a joyful world of freedom and sisterhood. When their creative circle is exposed, they face growing pressure and must find ways to protect their bond and support each other.

upcoming.title: Demon Dancer: Sua/Nara
upcoming.plot: After tragedy shatters her life, a professional ballerina allows a demon to possess her—transforming her body, movement, and rage into a deadly weapon.

upcoming.title: Violette
upcoming.plot: Violette Toussaint, a cemetery caretaker in a small town in Burgundy, is a unique observer and a compassionate listener. Her peaceful life is filled by conversations with quirky cemetery workers and the many visitors who share their stories of love, loss, and life. However, her routine is disrupted when a local police chief arrives at her door with an unusual request. As they grow closer, Violette comes to understand that the truth behind long-buried mysteries in her past must be uncovered if she wants to take another chance on life and, against all odds, love.

kids.title: Spirited Away
kids.plot: A young girl becomes trapped in a strange world of spirits after her parents undergo a mysterious transformation. She must find the courage to help her family and make her way through this unfamiliar place.

kids.title: Coco
kids.plot: Despite a generations-old family ban on music, a young boy dreams of becoming a musician. A mysterious turn of events takes him to the colorful Land of the Dead, where he joins a charming trickster on a journey to uncover the truth behind his family history.

kids.title: Home Alone
kids.plot: An eight-year-old boy is accidentally left home alone when his family leaves for a Christmas vacation. When burglars target the house, he uses his ingenuity to defend it.

kids.title: Forgotten Island
kids.plot: On their last night together, two high school graduates and best friends are transported through a mysterious portal to a fantastical island. To find their way home, they must face the possible loss of the memories that bind their friendship.

kids.title: Toy Story 5
kids.plot: When a young girl becomes absorbed in a new tablet, the toys find their efforts to keep playtime going much harder. They must face a new challenge as technology competes for her attention.

kids.title: Coyote vs. Acme
kids.plot: After Acme products repeatedly fail during a coyote’s pursuit of a speedy bird, he hires a billboard lawyer to sue the company. Their case brings the familiar cartoon mishaps into a courtroom.

kids.title: Steps
kids.plot: A misunderstood stepsister is blamed for disrupting a royal ball with a stolen magic wand. After a spell goes wrong, she teams up with Cinderella and an unexpected ally to try to save the kingdom and mend a fractured fairytale.

kids.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
kids.plot: A young boy is accidentally separated from his family and finds himself alone in New York during the Christmas season. With his dad’s credit card, he checks into a hotel, explores the city, and crosses paths with two familiar burglars whose plans he’s determined to stop.

kids.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
kids.plot: A Christmas-hating recluse sets out to take the holiday away from the cheerful residents of Whoville. When a kind young girl and her family reach out to him, their warmth may help him see the season differently.

kids.title: Hexed
kids.plot: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
